target.statement: BIC of the proposed S-CG-MoLE model fitted to the (uncontaminated) tone perception data, K=2, reported as -342.8331 (Table 5, S-CG-MoLE column, BIC row)
target.dataset: tone perception data (Cohen 1984), n=150, available in R package mixtools

compute.basis: Data is tiny (n=150) and CPU-only, but no code is released: the S-CG-MoLE ECM algorithm (local-linear kernel gating, contaminated-Gaussian experts, Newton-Raphson, bandwidth CV, EDF-based BIC) must be re-implemented from the paper's equations and debugged to match the reported BIC.

blockers: No code or supplementary material released; all six models' fitting routines (CGMLRs, CG-MoLE, S-GMoLE, S-CG-MoLE) must be written from scratch
Bandwidth selection via cross-validation and EDF-based degrees of freedom are only loosely specified, so exact BIC reproduction is uncertain
Reported BIC values are sensitive to initialization and convergence details not documented
title: Robust semi-parametric mixtures of linear experts using the contaminated Gaussian distribution
